title: The Showboat
about: Remembering the final year of the showboat before realizing it would be gone.
description: This track reflects on an ordinary afternoon exploring the showboat with friends during what none of us realized was its final season. Looking back, simple photographs became lasting memories of a place, a group of friends, and a chapter that quietly came to an end. It's about how we rarely recognize the last time until years later.
